neighbours.label: An outcome compared with what was expected or first intended ('than they expected', 'than initially budgeted', 'originally intended as'), firing on the words that turn to the earlier expectation; plain descriptions of the same things stay quiet.
fire: The repairs took far longer than anyone had anticipated.
The bridge cost more than initially budgeted.
Sales were lower than the company had projected.
The trip was harder than we thought it would be.
The house was originally intended as a summer home.
The plan worked out better than they had hoped.
The show, first planned as a short series, ran for years.
It turned out less useful than she expected.
quiet: The repairs took place at the old bridge downtown.
The bridge is long and carries two lanes.
Sales were held at the company store on Friday.
The trip was on a train through the mountains.
The house was painted white with green shutters.
The plan was printed and handed to them at noon.
The show, filmed in Toronto, stars a young cast.
It is a useful tool, and she owns two.

notes: The output direction promotes ' originally', ' underestimated', ' initially', ' anticipated'. Probes: 'than initially estimated' 0.69; plain sentences on the same topics under 0.07.
